text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Les produits exclus du domaine d’application du «principe Cassis de Dijon» sont inscrits sur une .", "gist": "Products excluded from the Cassis de Dijon principle are listed on a document."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "principe Cassis de Dijon", "gist": "Cassis de Dijon principle"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "UE", "gist": "European Union"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "EEE", "gist": "European Economic Area"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "denrées alimentaires", "gist": "food products"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Pour les denrées alimentaires, l’application du «principe Cassis de Dijon» est soumise à une réglementation spéciale (procédure d’autorisation).", "gist": "For food products, the Cassis de Dijon principle is subject to special regulation (authorization procedure)."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "une exception au «principe Cassis de Dijon»", "gist": "an exception to the Cassis de Dijon principle"}]}
